Wire HyperMillStrategyEngine to PRISM strategy recommendation pipeline.

sessions.title: MaterialBridge → SpeedFeedOrchestrator Wiring + ISO Group Resolution

smart_config.role: Materials Physics Engineer + MCP Wiring Specialist

sessions.intent: Connect hyperMILL's 2,544-material database to PRISM's physics engine so that any hyperMILL material selection (DIN, AISI, JIS, UNS, AFNOR, BS standards) automatically resolves to Kienzle kc1.1 constants and machinability factors for speed/feed calculation.

units.title: Wire MaterialBridge fuzzy match → MaterialRegistry → kc1.1 resolution chain
units.description: Create the resolution chain: hyperMILL material name (any standard) → MaterialBridge fuzzy match → ISO group classification → MaterialRegistry kc1.1 lookup → SpeedFeedOrchestrator input. Handle multi-standard aliases (e.g., 1.4404 = AISI 316L = X2CrNiMo17-12-2). Build hypermill-material-physics-gate hook that blocks operations if material cannot resolve to kc1.1.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Resolution chain handles all 6 material standards (DIN/AISI/JIS/UNS/AFNOR/BS)
Fuzzy match resolves 95%+ of hypermill-materials.json entries to ISO groups
hypermill-material-physics-gate hook blocks if kc1.1 is unresolvable
kc1.1 values come from constants.ts (never hardcoded)
5 unit tests covering each standard + fuzzy match + gate block

units.title: Wire MaterialMap ISO taxonomy to SpeedFeedOrchestrator resolver
units.description: Connect HyperMillMaterialMapEngine's 190-grade taxonomy to SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine as a new resolver. The orchestrator's 8 resolvers gain a 9th: hyperMILL material map resolver that uses ISO P/M/K/N/S/H group classification to select the correct kc1.1 and machinability correction factors. Include chipping class corrections from hypermill-materials-catalog.ts.

exit_criteria: SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine has hyperMILL resolver registered
Resolver uses ISO group + chipping class corrections
Machinability factors (HB, thermal conductivity) propagate to force model
A machinist querying 316L gets correct kc1.1=2100 and correction factors
4 unit tests: ISO P steel, ISO M stainless, ISO S titanium, ISO H hardened

units.title: Wire hypermill-cutting-tech.json speeds/feeds as calibration data for orchestrator
units.description: Load the 106 material cutting technology entries from hypermill-cutting-tech.json as calibration reference data in SpeedFeedOrchestratorEngine. These manufacturer-recommended speeds/feeds serve as validation bounds: PRISM's physics-computed values should be within +/-20% of hyperMILL's catalog values. Flag deviations for machinist review.

exit_criteria: 106 cutting tech entries loaded as calibration bounds
SpeedFeedOrchestrator compares physics output to hyperMILL catalog values
Deviations > 20% flagged with explanation (material property difference, tool geometry difference)
3 unit tests verify calibration comparison logic

sessions.title: PPP Default Path + Strategy Pipeline Wiring
sessions.intent: Make PPP the default post-processing path for hyperMILL NC output and wire HyperMillStrategyEngine to PRISM's strategy recommendation pipeline. Per-block S/F via AutoSpeedFeedEngine is already built — this session makes it the default, not an opt-in.

units.title: Wire PPP as default hyperMILL post-processing path
units.description: Configure PostProcessorPipelineEngine to be the default post-processing path for hyperMILL NC output. Create HyperMillPPPDefaultConfig that sets: (1) AutoSpeedFeedEngine as the default per-block optimizer, (2) hyperMILL controller dialect selection from HyperMillControllerCatalogEngine, (3) output path routing to hyperMILL project folder structure. This is a WIRE unit — AutoSpeedFeedEngine already does per-block S/F, we're making it the default path.

This enables cross-CAM strategy comparison (e.g., hyperMILL MAXX roughing vs Fusion adaptive clearing).
